column1: # ABLATION: R1 (#293) ONLY — R2 (#294)'s three-line rules-minimum guard removed from
#           and NOTHING else changed. This is the BP12 bisection artefact that attributes
#           `quality-ab-T2.tsv`'s flags to one fix or the other; it is NOT a baseline and no
#           later task compares against it. `+uncommitted-changes-under-crates` on the port
#           sha below is that removal and is the honest record of it.
# repeats-note: 1 is deliberate — the quality lane runs once whatever `--repeats` says, so the
#           incomplete / violation / neckdown columns are exactly as good as the three-repeat
#           run's. Only `cpu_s` is a single sample here and should be read as indicative.
#           (A key of its own: `# repeats:` below is the script's, and two lines with one key
#           would leave `read_tsv`'s header map holding whichever came last.)
